name: Manazuru Misaki
source: One of the childhood gang's members, her beauty is always attracting attention. During childhood her relationship with the gang was very good, but recently it became estranged. Her eyesight isn't very good, an due to this, Misaki has a habit of narrowing her eyes, which gives people a bad impression thinking her eyes are fierce, but in fact her personality isn't harsh at all. Does not like either glasses or contacts, so to this day she is still coping with her bad eyesight. Misaki also has a strong sense of justice and practices kendo.
